project.name: Format Rip Healthy Lifestyle V2
project.description: Trimmed prompt to fit under Replicate's 2000-char truncation limit

source.prompt:
STYLE: Late 90s PS1 low-poly 3D render. Match reference frames exactly — pixelated textures, jagged edges, no anti-aliasing, flat vertex lighting, vivid neon palette.

SHOT: vertical 9:16, locked-off static medium shot, no camera move.

SUBJECT: low-poly mid-20s scruffy guy in dark beanie, patchy beard, black hoodie. Sits cross-legged on the tiled floor of a low-poly 7-Eleven. A half-eaten low-poly hot dog rests in his lap on a paper tray, an open low-poly Mountain Dew bottle is next to him, candy wrappers scattered around. He holds a low-poly smartphone. Fluorescent ceiling lights, 7-Eleven branding visible behind him.

PERSISTENT OVERLAY (full 11s, top center): bold white sans-serif 'Healthy lifestyle in your 20s' with thick black stroke, exactly as in the overlay reference. Stays bolted to the top, never fades.

[0.0s-1.5s] BEAT 1: He stares at the phone, slightly slouched. A grey iMessage incoming bubble pops in mid-left of frame: 'you coming to the gym?'. AUDIO: clean Apple iMessage notification ding right at 0.0s, then quiet store hum.

[1.5s-4.5s] BEAT 2: He leans in with fake-confident posture and types. TWO blue iMessage bubbles appear stacked on the right: first 'yeah totally', then below it 'I'm grinding hard this month'. The hot dog and Mountain Dew remain clearly in his lap. AUDIO: silent typing taps and ambient store hum, no sfx.

[4.5s-11.0s] BEAT 3 — PUNCHLINE: At exactly 4.5s the bubbles vanish from screen. He puts the phone face-down on the floor, picks up the hot dog with both hands, and takes a huge slow-motion bite, eyes deadpan to camera, while reaching for the Mountain Dew. AUDIO: at 4.5s a single LOUD deep-bass 'Vine boom' impact (the iconic 'BWAH' hit), then chewing and the hiss of the Mountain Dew being opened.
